Inilah uraian pelindung keselamatan dan belas kasih, ada wejangan Lingkeswara kepada sang empu, serta berulang kembali.
Kedua, jenis-jenis penyakit tiwang (kejang/kelongsongan) yang menjadi sebab, pergerakan dari penyakit tiwang, masing-masing memiliki perbedaan dan perincian, ada tiwang dewa,
tiwang raksasa, tiwang gandarwa, tiwang bhuta, [tidak terbaca], serta tiwang satwa, tiwang manusia.

[Lembar 2]
Pengobatan bagi tiga puluh tiga jenis tiwang, hakikat kesuciannya menjaga tujuh budi keutamaan, pengampunan,
penjagaan dari tiwang paksi, ketetapannya, 1200, dimohonkan ampunan, bunga [tidak terbaca],
pelindung, [tidak terbaca]
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
Here is the description of protection and compassion, the teaching of Lingkeswara unto the master, repeated again.
Second, the afflictions of tiwang (seizures/convulsive disorders) and their causes, the manifestations of tiwang, distinct and varied, further categorized into: tiwang dewa,
tiwang rakshasa, tiwang gandharva, tiwang bhuta, [unreadable], as well as tiwang animal, tiwang human.

[Leaf 2]
Remedies for the thirty-three varieties of tiwang, their philosophical essence guarding the seven faculties of intellect, forgiveness,
protection against tiwang paksi (bird seizure), ordination/reckoning, 1200, seeking forbearance, flowers [unreadable],
protection, [unreadable]
